tools.description: List private non-binding Requests within the current approved scope. No arguments preserves the array of up to 100 most recently updated summaries. For bounded complete traversal, pass page={limit:5}; result then contains items, has_more and next_cursor. Continue with page={limit:5,...next_cursor}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.populardemand.market" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: demand_checks · Private data: list_future_purchases, get_future_purchase, get_purchase_offers, validate_offer, answer_question, save_future_purchase, reaffirm_future_purchase, set_purchase_reachability · Public sink: get_purchase_offers, save_future_purchase, update_future_purchase, set_purchase_reachability, demand_checks · Destructive: get_future_purchase.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: demand_checks · Private data: list_future_purchases, get_future_purchase, get_purchase_offers, validate_offer, answer_question, save_future_purchase, reaffirm_future_purchase, set_purchase_reachability · Public sink: get_purchase_offers, save_future_purchase, update_future_purchase, set_purchase_reachability, demand_checks · Destructive: get_future_purchase

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
